chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Aban and Jameel, from Zurara, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) narrated to us the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). So he called for a cup, took a handful of water, and poured it over his face. Then he wiped his face from both sides together. Then he returned his left hand to the vessel, poured it over his right hand, and wiped its sides. Then he returned his right hand to the vessel, poured it over his left hand, and did just as he had done with the right hand. Then he wiped with what remained in his hand upon his head and his two feet, and he did not return these two to the vessel.
ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet Muhammad perform his ritual ablution (wudu) according to Shia sources?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi provides a precise, step-by-step narration of the Prophet’s ablution, emphasizing the Shia practice of wiping the hands sequentially rather than washing them, and performing the foot wipe (masah) without re-immersion. It serves as a key textual evidence for the distinct Shia fiqh of wudu, particularly regarding the method of wiping the feet over the khuffs or skin, contrasting with the Sunni practice of washing. The narration highlights the ritual purity's physical execution as transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the authority of the Imams in defining prophetic practice.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Aban and Jameel, from Zurara who said,

‘Abu Ja’farasws imitated for us an Ablution (Wudhu) of Rasool-Allahsaww. So heasws called for a jug and took a handful of water and poured it upon hisasws face. Then heasws wiped hisasws face from both the sides together. Then heasws scooped (the water) by immersing his left hand into the vessel, so heasws poured it upon his right hand. Then heasws wiped its two sides. Then heasws scooped (the water) by immersing his right hand into the vessel, so heasws poured it upon his left hand. Then heasws did just as heasws had done with the right hand. Then heasws wiped with whatever remained in hisasws hand, upon hisasws head and hisasws feet, and heasws did not immerse these two into the vessel’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from Aban and Jamil from Zurarah who has said the following:

“Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once demonstrated for us how the Messenger of Allah would take Wudu. He asked for a glass of water. He (the Imam) then with some water in the palm of his hand allowed it to flow down his face and wiped both sides of his face. He (the Imam) then with some water in the palm of his left hand allowed it to flow down his right hand and then wiped both sides. He (the Imam) with some water in the palm of his right hand allowed it to flow over his left and did as he had done to his right hand. Thereafter he, with whatever was left on his hand, wiped his head and feet but he did not place his hands in the water container (again).”
